expected.reason: Lines 120-126: an enabled file uses `deletingPathExtension()` (strips only `.jar`), but a disabled file uses `String(filename.dropLast(".jar.disabled".count))` -- a plain deletingPathExtension() on `X.jar.disabled` would only strip `.disabled` and leave `X.jar`, which is why the disabled branch is handled with an explicit drop-suffix instead. Both paths converge on the identical stem regardless of enabled state, which is what lets the same jarStem key be used across enable/disable/update.
